summary: Governance is directionally coherent and operationally stable. No artifact changes occurred in the product since the March 15 nightly report. The three priorities from code remain correct and in the right order. Health remains yellow because the two main execution gaps — assembly consumability/packaging and machine-checkable coverage of assembly integrity — are still open, and both are now reinforced by the Control Tower's overnight creation of a governance intake signal (assembly-packaging-decision) for morning triage.

materialChanges.description: Control Tower created governance intake signal 'intake:governance:2026-03-15:assembly-packaging-decision' during overnight synthesis on 2026-03-15. This signal explicitly targets the Priority 2 assembly packaging/consumability gap and is pending TDE triage. It does not change the priority ranking but adds explicit downstream pressure on the assembly question.

topPriorities.title: Operate Governance as a real product with explicit outcomes and reviewable progress
topPriorities.whyThisMattersNow: Governance must model the same explicit goal/evidence/priority discipline it imposes on the rest of the portfolio. Credibility depends on this self-discipline being visible and reviewable.
topPriorities.currentStatus: Holding. Governance product stack is active, well-structured, and being exercised through recurring nightly reporting. No drift detected against plan/metrics/decisions.
topPriorities.nextConcreteStep: Continue explicit priorities, metrics, and review-output discipline. Verify the next formal product review aligns with the monthly cadence declared in MODEL.yaml (last_reviewed: 2026-03-11).

topPriorities.title: Complete Governance assembly v0.1 into a clearly consumable and verifiable pack
topPriorities.whyThisMattersNow: Governance only delivers transferable downstream value when the assembly can be installed, verified, reviewed, and maintained without hidden assumptions. Assembly is still 'candidate' status. A governance intake signal for this decision was raised overnight and is awaiting triage.
topPriorities.currentStatus: Blocked on packaging/consumability decision. Assembly artifact structure exists (assembly.yaml, ACTIVATION.md, VERIFY.md, policy/ops artifacts), but the explicit packaging decision and verification-semantics alignment remain open. Intake signal raised by Control Tower confirms this is cross-system visible.
topPriorities.nextConcreteStep: Triage 'intake:governance:2026-03-15:assembly-packaging-decision' in TDE. Make the packaging model explicit. Align VERIFY.md to the chosen model. Promote assembly status from candidate when packaging is confirmed.

topPriorities.title: Extend machine-checkable governance toward the assembly surface and source-of-truth integrity
topPriorities.whyThisMattersNow: Governance's main leverage is machine-enforced validation. The next control-quality gain is reducing drift between product state, assembly state, and what the repo actually ships. This remains explicitly unresolved per plan and risks.
topPriorities.currentStatus: Active but not yet staged. Repo-level validation is a known strength; assembly integrity/completeness is not yet part of that control surface per RISKS.md#R-003 and PLAN.md objectives 3-4.
topPriorities.nextConcreteStep: Define and stage the next validator increment for assembly integrity/completeness. Ensure product/assembly/source-of-truth linkages are explicit in governance artifacts. This should follow (not precede) the Priority 2 packaging decision.

constraints.title: Governance assembly v0.1 packaging/consumability decision is still open
constraints.impact: Blocks Priority 2 from progressing; prevents assembly from moving from 'candidate' to a clearly-installed and verifiable state downstream.

constraints.title: Machine-checkable governance does not yet cover assembly integrity/completeness
constraints.impact: Leaves a meaningful gap between governance intent and enforceable control over the assembly export surface.

risksOrOpportunities.title: Governance product can lag behind the standards it expects from other products
risksOrOpportunities.note: Nightly reporting and explicit priority refresh discipline are actively mitigating this.

risksOrOpportunities.title: Governance assembly remains scaffolded rather than truly consumable
risksOrOpportunities.note: Unchanged since yesterday. Packaging decision intake signal now raised and awaiting triage — small positive signal.

risksOrOpportunities.title: Machine-checkable governance does not yet cover the assembly surface strongly enough
risksOrOpportunities.note: Dependency on Priority 2 packaging decision before meaningful extension is feasible.

risksOrOpportunities.title: Registry and source-of-truth relationships can drift
risksOrOpportunities.note: No new drift detected; INTERFACES.md product-vs-assembly boundary rule is still explicit and holding.

proposedTdeActions.title: Triage 'intake:governance:2026-03-15:assembly-packaging-decision'
proposedTdeActions.why: This intake signal is the most concrete current handle on the Priority 2 packaging/consumability gap. Triaging it into a decision or work item unblocks the assembly progression path.

proposedTdeActions.title: Stage the next validator increment for assembly integrity/completeness
proposedTdeActions.why: Closes the main machine-checkable governance gap once packaging decision is settled. Sequenced after Priority 2.

proposedTdeActions.title: Confirm next formal product review is on track per monthly cadence (last: 2026-03-11)
proposedTdeActions.why: MODEL.yaml declares monthly review cadence. Next due ~2026-04-11. Priority 1 discipline requires this to be visible and planned.
